---
title: Scholar metadata for a CSL JSON bibliography
format: html
google-scholar: true
bibliography: references.json
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      ensureHtmlElements:
        - ['meta[name="citation_reference"][content*="citation_author=Alice Smith;"]']
---

The bibliography is a CSL JSON file. Pandoc reads a bare `.json` input as its own JSON AST, so the Scholar reference tags need the bibliography read explicitly as CSL JSON.

This article cites one work [@cited].
